race.comment: BIG RED TEQUILA (12) is a distance specialist who finished over the top of inferior opposition last start with a comfortable victory as fav over 1100m at Rosehill. Will appreciate the fast tempo and drop in weight fourth-up. Hard to hold out. ICE KOOL (5) undefeated in three runs at this course and kept fresh in a tougher race. Stamped his class with the 60kg as fav with a slick win in fast time over 1000m here on a rain affected track. Kept up to the mark with a tick over trial win and can remain undefeated. HAWKER HALL (6) classy sprinter resuming. Came to the end of his prep with a wilting eighth in the Prov Mid Champs over 1200m at Gosford last March. Saves his best for this trip and trialled well. ISTOLEA MERC (13) keep safe from the draw.
